# blockmalloc

[![CI](https://github.com/array2d/blockmalloc/actions/workflows/libblock_malloc.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/array2d/blockmalloc/actions/workflows/libblock_malloc.yml)

A fixed-size memory block allocator (block pool) in C11 with no external dependencies.

See [`include/blockmalloc/blockmalloc.h`](include/blockmalloc/blockmalloc.h) for the full API and memory layout.
